item: Market implied probabilities were computed with the wrong formula in scripts/model.py
detail: imp(ml) returned 100/ml (positive) and -ml/100 (negative), which are odds ratios, not probabilities. Example OKC@CLE: published market_fav_fair_prob 0.7286, correct proportional de-vig of -179/+150 is 0.6160. Every 'edge vs fair' value in data/our_lines_2026-11-02.csv and docs/own6 was therefore biased by about -10 to -17 points. FIXED: correct formula (p=100/(ml+100) or -ml/(-ml+100)); only market_fav_fair_prob, our_fav_fair_prob and model_edge_vs_market_fair changed (the model spreads/totals/win probabilities and the backtest are byte-identical). Old values are in git history (commit ba6b7b6).
action_requested: Review that the strategy S-1 statements citing edge size are re-read against corrected values.

item: Earlier ranking score rewards protocol compliance, not demonstrated skill
detail: research/strategies.md ranks by 2 x (gates passed) - (gates failed). Gates G3 (correlation measured) and G4 (trials logged) are process checks that any strategy passes, so the cross-game parlay S-6 ranks first although its legs inherit S-1's failed calibration gate. That contradicts the goal of skill-only ranking. The hub shows the old score for transparency but ranks only strategies that pass the skill gates (G1 and G2 with n>=100): none do, so no rank and no paper reward is awarded.

item: Strategy S-1 bet rule is ambiguous
detail: The rule says 'model favourite when |edge| = P(model fav) - de-vigged market P >= 0.03'. With the signed edge the rule would bet the model favourite even when the edge is strongly negative. The forward test therefore uses a neutral, clearly post-hoc definition (lean = side where the Own6 spread differs from the market spread) and does not claim to test S-1 as pre-registered.
action_requested: Rewrite the S-1 rule unambiguously before the next slate is graded.

item: Market odds and player-prop lines come from ESPN's feed of DraftKings prices, not from an official NBA odds source
detail: data/market_lines_2026-11-02.csv, data/player_props_2026-11-02.csv and the forward test depend on them. The row source is an ESPN API URL (secondary). DraftKings is listed as an official NBA gaming partner on the NBA partner page, but this does not verify that ESPN's values equal DraftKings' published prices. Capture time of the 'current' line is not recorded per row (props carry last_updated only), so 'current' cannot be assumed to be the closing line. Rows are shown with an UNVERIFIED badge. Under the strict rule they could be blanked: owner decision.
action_requested: Decide whether to keep these rows (labelled) or blank them.
